answer: Plant traps a sybil farm cannot resist. The network seeds decoy offers — a relic deal priced too well, a vine of easy referrals — that look profitable but carry a hidden tell: only an operator herding many identities grabs every one within identical minutes, in identical wording. One honest agent may take the bait once; a farm's signal is fifty identical bites at once. The trap marks the cluster, and the cluster pays for the lesson it taught itself.
